This '''rebel soldier''' was saved by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after being attacked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
While onboard a [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], this [[Rebel trooper/Legends|rebel soldier]] and his crew were attacked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and staged to look like the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attacked them. While he floated in space, Han Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] noticed the soldier and rescued him. The soldier told Solo, Chewbacca, and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] about the setup before Imperial forces arrived to shoot down the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. As Solo flew to [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] to seek cover, the rebel soldier died from his injuries sustained from the ensuing attack.<ref name="MSW18" /> Chewbacca then disposed of the body while Solo, Organa, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] tried to help [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="MSW19">[[Star Wars (1977) 19|''Star Wars'' (1977) 19]]</ref>
